info.name: 4. WorkFitAI - Application Service
info.description:
Job Application Management with CV Upload, Status Tracking & Draft Support

**Base URL:** {{base_url}}/application
**Port:** 9084 -> 9085 (gateway)
**Consul:** application
**DB:** MongoDB + MinIO
**Events:** Kafka

**Application Status Flow:**
APPLIED → REVIEWED → SHORTLISTED → INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED → INTERVIEW_COMPLETED → OFFER → ACCEPTED (or REJECTED)

**Features:**
- Draft applications
- CV file upload (MultipartFile)
- Application assignment
- HR notes management
- Bulk operations
- Company-wide filtering
